## Description

Provide a summary of the website or documentation changes made. Link relevant issue if applicable.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Website component / UI fix
- [ ] New feature / integration
- [ ] Styling / CSS / Accessibility fix

## Quality Gates Checklist

- [ ] `bun run build` (or `npm run build`) compiles cleanly without MDX or TypeScript errors
- [ ] All new doc pages are registered in `docs.json` (if applicable)
- [ ] Links and code snippets render correctly across desktop and mobile screens
